name: app-dark-skeuomorphic-tab-bar-with-glowing-add-button
title: Dark Skeuomorphic Tab Bar
whatItIs: A dark grey segmented navigation bar of five keys (home, chart, plus, chat, profile) with embossed icons, the centre plus lit white with a red indicator dash.
whatItMeans: Physical-looking keys make navigation feel tactile, and one lit key shows the active state clearly.
techniques: Embossed grey icons on dark keys
Active key lit white with a red dash
Dark on dark for a hardware feel

vocabulary.definition: The highlighted item in a segmented control.
A raised look given to icons or shapes.
